name: web-scraper-app
description: A web scraping application that collects data from a website and transfers it to an application.

scripts.scrape:single: npm run build && MATCH_URL="https://www.cricketbaroda.com/match/17797270/Y.S.C-Women-vs-Combined-Disrict-Women---1" ts-node dist/index.js single
scripts.scrape:pipeline: npm run build && ts-node dist/index.js pipeline
scripts.scrape:tournament: npm run build && PIPELINE_MODE=tournament TOURNAMENT_URL="https://www.cricketbaroda.com/tournament/12345" ts-node dist/index.js pipeline
scripts.scrape:matches: npm run build && PIPELINE_MODE=matches URLS="https://www.cricketbaroda.com/match/1,https://www.cricketbaroda.com/match/2" ts-node dist/index.js pipeline
